title: Lock-free single-producer single-consumer queue
prompt: Implement a header-only `template <typename T, std::size_t Capacity> class SpscQueue` in the global namespace: a bounded, lock-free, single-producer single-consumer ring buffer.
- `bool try_push(T value)` returns false (and leaves the queue unchanged) when full.
- `std::optional<T> try_pop()` returns std::nullopt when empty. Elements come out in FIFO order.
- `std::size_t size_approx() const` returns the number of elements (may be stale under concurrency but never larger than Capacity).
- The queue must hold exactly Capacity elements (not Capacity - 1). Capacity is not necessarily a power of two.
- One producer thread and one consumer thread may call try_push / try_pop concurrently. Use std::atomic with appropriate memory orderings; no mutexes.
- T may be move-only and need not be default constructible. Elements still in the queue must be destroyed when the queue is destroyed.
